offering_description.value: Processes and packages canned and frozen vegetables, canned fruit and snack foods under its own brands and private labels. Sells mainly to grocery retailers, food distributors and food service customers, and also to other food companies.

primary_products.value: canned vegetables; frozen vegetables; canned fruit; private label foods; snack foods

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, wholesalers, food service operators, private label retail customers

end_markets.value: grocery retail; food service; consumer packaged foods

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged vegetables, fruit and snack foods sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes and packs vegetables and fruit from farm-grown crops, sold to retailers and food companies; brand owner: sells its own brands and licensed brands to grocery retailers

geography_served.value: US national: sells across the United States, with some exports

specialization.value: related lines: canned and frozen vegetables, canned fruit and snack foods, sold to overlapping grocery and food service customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national grocery chains and food service accounts; distributors / dealers: food distributors that resell to regional grocers and restaurants; agents / brokers: food brokers that sell to retail and wholesale buyers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from the FDA and USDA, including FSMA food safety requirements

notes: Product lines and brand licenses may have changed; details are based on general knowledge of the company.
